title: Cohors Cthulhu NPC
description: One NPC, ready for import into the Cohors Cthulhu Roll20 sheet via api-scripts/ccimport.js. See ../FORMAT.md for a full walkthrough. A file may contain either a single object matching this schema, or a JSON array of them for a batch of NPCs.

name.description: The NPC's name - becomes the Roll20 character's name.

npc_type.description: The profile's NPC type from the GM's Guide (the line under its name, e.g. "TOUGHENED NPC"). Trooper and Toughened use the sheet's compact combat layout; Nemesis gets the full sheet. Also sets the tier defaults for Max Stress (Troopers halve it) and injuries (1/2/3).

allegiance.description: Adversaries buy d20s with Threat and turn extra successes into Threat; allies use the party's Momentum like a PC. Can be switched on the sheet at any time.

truths.description: The profile's TRUTHS lines, one per entry (Troopers have one, Toughened one or two, Nemesis two).

archetype.description: Free text, matches the PC sheet's own Archetype field - an NPC's archetype rarely matches the fixed PC dropdown list exactly, so this is plain text here.

attributes.description: Ratings for all seven Attributes (rulebook scale, typically 6-16). Use null for an attribute the profile prints as "—" (e.g. an animal's Gravitas); the sheet treats it as 0. Extraordinary bonuses printed in parentheses, like "Brawn 13(2)", go in special_rules, not here.

skills.description: Only list skills this NPC actually has ranks in - most NPCs (especially Minions/Toughened) only need a couple. Keys must be one of this game's twelve skill names.

talents.description: Either a name matching this game's talent list (source/data/talents.json) - the importer fills in Keywords/Requirements/Description automatically, same as picking it from the dropdown on a PC sheet - or a custom {name, description} pair for an NPC-only special ability not in that list.

description.description: Omit to resolve name against the known talent list; include to define a custom ability instead.

name.description: Any name. A name matching this sheet's Weapons suggestion list (see source/views/panels/_weapons_panel.pug) auto-fills the other fields unless overridden; anything else (Claws, Horrific Presence) is a custom attack.

damage_effects.description: e.g. "3, Vicious" - damage in Challenge Dice followed by comma-separated Damage Effects. For NPCs, copy the profile's printed damage exactly: it already includes attribute bonus damage, Brutal and Fearsome, so the sheet adds nothing on top.

type.description: Attack type. "mental" for the profile's (Mental Attack) entries; omit for weapons to infer melee/ranged from focus.

weapons.description: The profile's ATTACKS or WEAPONS AND ARMOR entries, including mental attacks. Armor items go in armor, not here.

name.description: Matching a name in this sheet's Armor dropdown (see source/views/panels/_armor_panel.pug) auto-fills resistance/qualities below unless overridden.

stress.description: Current Stress already marked, if this NPC should start partway hurt. The maximum goes in profile.stress.

injuries.description: Injuries already sustained (free text). The injury limit goes in profile.injuries.

profile.description: The stat block's printed totals (STRESS, INJURIES, ARMOR, COURAGE, Power). They already include every special rule's bonus, so they are written to the sheet as-is and win over the sheet's own formulas. Omit any the profile doesn't print.

injuries.description: Printed injuries before defeat (includes Tough X).

armor.description: Printed Armor resistance, including worn armor and Natural Armor.

courage.description: Printed Courage resistance, including Natural Courage.

special_rules.description: The profile's SPECIAL RULES. Common ones (Fearsome, Brutal, Tough, Extraordinary Brawn, Natural Armor...) fill in a summary on the sheet if description is omitted; give the profile's own wording in description for anything specific to this NPC.

name.description: As printed, e.g. "Fearsome 2", "Immune to Cold", "Extraordinary Brawn 2".

x.description: The rule's X, if it has one. Optional when the name ends with the number.

spellcasting.description: For NPC spellcasters ("uses Will to cast spells").

tradition.description: Spellbook the spells come from. The Mythos tomes are cthulhu (Tome of Cthulhu), mormo (Compendium of Mormo), nyarlathotep (Grimoire of Nyarlathotep) and yog_sothoth (Spellbook of Yog-Sothoth).

spells.description: Spell names from spellcasting.tradition, spelled as in source/data/spells.json. Skill/Difficulty/Cost/Effect fill in when the sheet is first opened.

rituals.description: Ritual names the profile lists. Rituals aren't battlefield spells, so they're recorded in the NPC's notes.

escalation_options.description: The profile's ESCALATION OPTIONS, one entry each, written out in full (e.g. "Totemic Staff: (Melee), Reach 2, 5, Drain, Stun"). Also add an escalation weapon to weapons as "<Name> (Escalation)" so it can be rolled.

focuses.description: Focus names this NPC knows for this skill, exactly as spelled in that skill's Focus list (see source/views/panels/_skills_panel.pug) - e.g. ["Melee Weapons"] for fighting.
